prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1385; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear quarter panel and left taillight assembly show crumpling and cracked lens, consistent with a rear-side impact while the other vehicle was turning left. Damage pattern matches the account given. Repair plan calls for panel replacement, paint blending, and lamp assembly swap, with labor hours in line with the scope. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record. Two similar charges posted to the same account on the same day are under review before payment is released.
